prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a confident street-fashion editorial portrait based on the approved reference of a clearly adult woman with hair cascading over her shoulders, a direct confident gaze, and a relaxed unbothered closed-lip expression. She stands slightly angled but faces forward, making a peace sign toward the camera with her right hand while her left arm rests naturally. Drape an oversized denim jacket over her shoulders like a cape and keep the white cropped top with fictional black graphic text and matching denim bottoms. Frame a 4:5 three-quarter-body composition above the knees with multiple adult hands holding smartphones entering from all four edges, creating a frame-within-frame effect. Set the scene in a clean studio with a white wall covered in fictional handwritten notes, scribbles, tape pieces, clips, and denim swatches. Use a 60mm lens, large approximately 5000K frontal softbox, Fujifilm ASTIA-inspired soft commercial color, natural skin texture, controlled shadows, and realistic phone reflections. Keep the pose non-sexual, the subject clearly adult, and all text fictional and unbranded.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, childlike styling, exaggerated pout, real logo, real handle, watermark, harsh shadows, hard flash, shallow depth of field, grainy, soft focus, overexposed, uneven lighting, distorted perspective, extra fingers, deformed hands, illegible notes
